Arthur Quiller-Couch, comp.  The Oxford Book of Victorian Verse.  1922.

The Elements

William H. Davies (1871–1940)

N
O
 house of stone
Was built for me;
When the Sun shines—
I am a bee.
No sooner comes
The Rain so warm,
I come to light—
I am a worm.
When the Winds blow,
I do not strip,
But set my sails—
I am a ship.
When Lightning comes,
It plays with me
And I with it—
I am a tree.
When drown’d men rise
At Thunder’s word,
Sings Nightingale—
I am a bird.
